areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Only the digital layer of smart-city products; no mobility, housing or sanitation investment; tangential indicators; resource share small; limited impact.

areas.name: Digital inclusion and connectivity
areas.reason: Core area: general and all specific objectives, all components and ten SMART indicators match; relevant share of resources; high impact, shared among areas; efficient and innovative solutions.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: Several specific objectives and two components directly on government digitalisation; four SMART indicators; relevant but not predominant resource share; moderate impact; efficient solutions.

areas.name: Science, technology and innovation
areas.reason: Programme finances adoption of existing technologies (operational modernisation), not science, technology and innovation; no research indicators.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: Capacity building is instrumental to digitalisation; no indicator measures state capacity; share of resources for the area in the strict sense is small.

not_accepted.name: Science, technology and innovation
not_accepted.reason: Programme finances adoption of existing technologies (operational modernisation), not science, technology and innovation; no research indicators.

not_accepted.name: State capacity
not_accepted.reason: Capacity building is instrumental to digitalisation; no indicator measures state capacity; share of resources for the area in the strict sense is small.

bonus.reason: Proponent did not state exclusive aim at federal priorities; resources are spread over several objectives rather than a single priority.
Proponent did not claim regional integration; project does not prioritise frontier-zone municipalities or show cross-border exchange potential.
